## Behavior

Describe the caller-visible problem and result. Link the relevant library checklist outcome. State any API or migration impact.

## Validation and review

List meaningful commands/scenarios actually run and their results. State skipped external checks and prerequisites. For a reproduced defect, include the original assertion failure and corrected behavior.

- [ ] Verification is appropriate to the change and passes; integration/cancellation boundaries are covered where relevant.
- [ ] Behavioral changes received independent FP/ZIO and invariant review; concrete findings are resolved and affected corrections were rechecked. Name the actual reviewers here.
- [ ] Affected usage/API/migration documentation and the single completion checklist are current, in English, with valid local links.
- [ ] Remaining limitations and upstream adaptations are explicit; no broad readiness claim follows from a local test or review.

Documentation-only changes may mark behavioral checks inapplicable with a reason. Do not copy review journals or per-file hashes into READMEs.
